import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_VERTICES = 5500;
    static final int MAX_ARCS = 35500;
    static final int INFINITY_COST = 1000000000;

    static class NetworkArc {
        int next_arc;
        int destination;
        int capacity;
        int cost;

        NetworkArc(int next_arc, int destination, int capacity, int cost) {
            this.next_arc = next_arc;
            this.destination = destination;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static NetworkArc[] arc = new NetworkArc[2 * MAX_ARCS + 10];
    static int[] adjacency_head = new int[MAX_VERTICES + 1];
    static int arc_index = 1;

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap, int c) {
        arc[++arc_index] = new NetworkArc(adjacency_head[u], v, cap, c);
        adjacency_head[u] = arc_index;
        arc[++arc_index] = new NetworkArc(adjacency_head[v], u, 0, -c);
        adjacency_head[v] = arc_index;
    }

    static int source_node, sink_node;
    static int[] parent_vertex = new int[MAX_VERTICES + 1];
    static int[] parent_arc = new int[MAX_VERTICES + 1];
    static int[] node_flow = new int[MAX_VERTICES + 1];
    static int[] distance = new int[MAX_VERTICES + 1];
    static boolean[] is_queued = new boolean[MAX_VERTICES + 1];

    static int spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(distance, 0x3f3f3f3f);
        Arrays.fill(node_flow, 0);
        node_flow[source_node] = INFINITY_COST;
        distance[source_node] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.offer(source_node);
        is_queued[source_node] = true;

        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = Q.poll();
            is_queued[u] = false;

            for (int e = adjacency_head[u]; e != 0; e = arc[e].next_arc) {
                int v = arc[e].destination;
                if (arc[e].capacity > 0 && distance[v] > distance[u] + arc[e].cost) {
                    distance[v] = distance[u] + arc[e].cost;
                    node_flow[v] = Math.min(node_flow[u], arc[e].capacity);
                    parent_arc[v] = e;
                    parent_vertex[v] = u;
                    if (!is_queued[v]) {
                        is_queued[v] = true;
                        Q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return node_flow[sink_node];
    }

    static int N, M, K, C_val, D_val;
    static int[][] schedule = new int[105][105];
    static int[][] edge_state = new int[105][105];
    static class Trip {
        int origin, destination;
        Trip(int origin, int destination) {
            this.origin = origin;
            this.destination = destination;
        }
    }
    static Trip[] trips = new Trip[105];

    static int COORD_NODE(int row, int col) {
        return row * N + col;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner cin = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = cin.nextInt();
        M = cin.nextInt();
        K = cin.nextInt();
        C_val = cin.nextInt();
        D_val = cin.nextInt();

        source_node = COORD_NODE(N + K, N) + 1;
        sink_node = source_node + 2;

        connect(COORD_NODE(0, 1), sink_node, INFINITY_COST, 0);

        for (int i = 1, p; i <= K; ++i) {
            p = cin.nextInt();
            connect(source_node, COORD_NODE(0, p), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= M; ++i) {
            int origin = cin.nextInt();
            int destination = cin.nextInt();
            trips[i * 2] = new Trip(origin, destination);
            trips[i * 2 - 1] = new Trip(destination, origin);
        }
        M <<= 1;

        for (int t = 1; t <= N + K; ++t) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i)
                connect(COORD_NODE(t - 1, i), COORD_NODE(t, i), INFINITY_COST, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= M; ++i) {
                connect(COORD_NODE(t - 1, trips[i].origin), COORD_NODE(t, trips[i].destination), 1, D_val);
                schedule[t][i] = arc_index;
                edge_state[t][i] = 1;
            }
            connect(COORD_NODE(t, 1), sink_node, INFINITY_COST, t * C_val);
        }

        int augment_amount;
        int result_cost = 0;
        while ((augment_amount = spfa()) > 0) {
            int v = sink_node;
            while (v != source_node) {
                int u = parent_vertex[v];
                arc[parent_arc[v]].capacity -= augment_amount;
                arc[parent_arc[v] ^ 1].capacity += augment_amount;
                v = u;
            }
            result_cost += distance[sink_node] * augment_amount;

            for (int t = 1; t <= N + N; ++t)
                for (int i = 1; i <= M; ++i)
                    if (arc[schedule[t][i]].capacity > 0) {
                        edge_state[t][i]++;
                        connect(COORD_NODE(t - 1, trips[i].origin), COORD_NODE(t, trips[i].destination), 1,
                                D_val * (edge_state[t][i] * 2 - 1));
                        schedule[t][i] = arc_index;
                    }
        }

        System.out.println(result_cost);
    }
}
